name: mirage-bench-pairwise-judgments
description:
MIRAGE-Bench Pairwise Judgments
	

Win matrix per language from nthakur/mirage-bench-pairwise-judgments. Each cell (row, col) shows the win rate of the row model against the col model, computed as wins / total_comparisons × 100%. Ties are counted as 0.5 wins for each side. Each row in the dataset is treated as an independent outcome.


	
		
		Arabic (ar)
